basics.name: Dipronil Das
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience specializing in React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. Experienced in building scalable REST APIs, microservices, real-time systems, payment integrations, database optimization, and cloud-based applications. Delivered up to 40% reduction in API and database latency while developing high-performance, SEO-friendly web applications.

responsibilities: Engineered high-throughput REST APIs using Hono/SvelteKit, achieving sub-100ms response times for real-time valet tracking.
Optimized database performance through indexing, query optimization, and connection pooling, reducing latency by 40% during peak traffic.
Built a scalable URL shortening service with efficient redirection, unique short-link generation, and reliable API handling.
Architected real-time ticket synchronization using WebSockets for instant bidirectional updates across attendant devices.
Integrated Stripe payments with webhook validation to ensure reliable transaction processing.
Worked with AWS services including EC2, S3, and CloudWatch for deployment and monitoring.
Developed 20+ REST APIs for high-traffic e-commerce applications.
Integrated Cashfree payment and logistics APIs for automated order fulfillment.
Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT and role-based access control.
Refactored database schemas and optimized PostgreSQL queries to improve application performance and data consistency.
Established standardized application logging, decreasing debugging time by approximately 40%.
Developed payment-processing microservices for reconciliation and transaction workflows.
Implemented reliable ACID-compliant transaction processing for high-volume financial operations.
Automated application QA by implementing unit test suites using Jest.

projects.name: SecondHugs – Multi-Vendor Marketplace
projects.description: SEO-optimized multi-vendor marketplace supporting vendor onboarding, product catalogs, shopping workflows, and order lifecycle management.
highlights: Built scalable marketplace workflows for vendors, products, carts, and orders.
Implemented secure Cashfree checkout and payment integration.
Improved application performance using server-side rendering and optimized API integration.

projects.name: Check Valet
projects.description: Cross-platform valet booking and vehicle tracking platform supporting booking, payment, attendant assignment, and real-time vehicle status updates.
highlights: Built scalable valet booking and payment workflows.
Implemented real-time ticket synchronization using WebSockets.
Developed React Native applications for valet attendants.
Optimized database queries and schema design for high-volume booking operations.

projects.name: AI SQL Assistant
projects.description: AI-powered SQL assistant that converts natural-language questions into SQL queries and executes validated read-only queries against a database.
highlights: Generated SQL queries from natural-language questions using the OpenAI API.
Implemented SQL validation to prevent destructive database operations.
Used Redis caching to reduce repeated SQL-generation requests.
Added query explanation and optimization capabilities.
